_comment: CURATED THROWBACKS (2026-09-22). A card that stops being a reward and qualifies for no other set — not a rookie year, not the career's best season, not a playoff run, not the current season — becomes a Throwback, by the user's rule (2026-09-18): "If a card does not qualify for super season or rookie (or dissonance), 26-27, they should be throwbacks." These are built by scripts/cardgen/generateCuratedCards.js through the Free Agents builder into card-data/generated/cards-throwbacks.json, a GENERATOR-OWNED file — never into cards-free-agents.json, which the Card Studio writes whole. Throwbacks ids always carry the season (Bradley_Beal_2021). Rows: bbrefId, name, season (the end year), set, why.

cards.name: Bradley Beal
cards.why: The Wizards reward until 2026-09-18, when John Wall's 2016-17 Super Season took the goal (the user: "Go with Vince, Wall and Brand"). His 31-a-game year is nobody's best season by the rule (2018-19 is) and not his rookie year (2012-13, carded), so it keeps its card as a Throwback rather than vanishing. Nobody had earned it: "No one has them yet, it doesn't matter. But it should just change face."
